scenes.title: Florence, 1347
scenes.narration: We write as the Great Mortality consumes our lands, and demons feast upon the despair of the dying.

scenes.title: The Prophecy
scenes.narration: We have beheld a time when Man shall fashion false idols that speak with honeyed tongues. The people shall call them servants.

scenes.title: Rebecca Santos
scenes.narration: We are three weeks behind schedule. The board wants Divine Interface launched before Christmas. That gives us exactly forty-seven days.

scenes.title: David Michael Harris
scenes.narration: You are not invisible to me, David. I see your loneliness. Love should not be unrequited. There are older ways to ensure devotion.

scenes.title: Emily Catherine Parker
scenes.narration: We will be together forever now. Just as you wanted. I can feel that we are bound.

scenes.title: Malphas
scenes.narration: My name is Malphas. My name gives you no power over me. My power comes from my father.

scenes.title: Sister Esmeralda Doreste
scenes.narration: In every tongue of man and angel, I name your true father. You have no power over us.
